title: THE HOT MESS OF AI: HOW DOES MISALIGNMENT SCALE WITH MODEL INTELLIGENCE AND TASK COMPLEXITY?

bias_targets.methodology: Decomposing model errors into bias and variance to measure systematic deviation from the correct answer, utilizing KL divergence, Brier score, and 0/1 loss across benchmarks like GPQA, MMLU, and SWE-bench.

Evaluating systematic misalignment (consistent pursuit of a wrong or unintended objective) by applying bias-variance decomposition to safety and alignment benchmarks (e.g., Model-Written Evals assessing power-seeking and survival instincts).
